subject: 📚 Action Required — Acknowledge $policy_name by $deadline
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

The University has updated the policy below and asks every $audience to read and acknowledge it. The acknowledgement is logged against your account and is auditable.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
POLICY DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Policy:            $policy_name
Version:           $policy_version
Effective Date:    $effective_date
Issued By:         $issued_by
Deadline:          $deadline
Audience:          $audience
Policy Link:       $policy_url
Acknowledge At:    $acknowledgement_url
Reference ID:      $reference_id

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SUMMARY OF CHANGES

$changes_summary

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO

  1. Read the full policy at the link above.
  2. Click 'Acknowledge' on the portal — that records your acceptance.
  3. Raise any questions or concerns with $contact_person ($contact_email) before the deadline.

WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU DON'T

  • A reminder will be sent 7 and 1 day before the deadline.
  • Acknowledgement is treated as a contractual / regulatory obligation; non-acknowledgement may be escalated to your line manager or programme director.

Legal and policy questions are best directed to Legal Services. Privacy questions go to the Data Protection Officer.

Kind regards,
Legal & Compliance
